records.real_world_identity_notes: AMS2 names the car generically as Citroen DS3 RX. FIA classifications establish a Citroen DS3 entry in the 2016 World Rallycross Championship, while the applicable SuperCar regulations establish dog-engagement construction. The exact team car, season, livery and gearbox unit fitted to the AMS2 representation are not established, so the year is recorded as an era rather than an exact build.

records.specification_basis: The current guided drive selected six forward gears through a sequential stick. FIA Article 279 permits at most six forward gears and permits a sequential layout, so the drive rather than the rule establishes those two values. The rule separately requires dog engagement and prohibits synchronisers and secondary clutch mechanisms, establishing dogbox construction for the SuperCar. It does not establish clutch technique, the cut in this implementation, or downshift blipping.
records.confidence_notes: Six gears, sequential-stick actuation, a standing-start clutch, clutchless running shifts and the upshift cut were observed directly. The latest two-stage drive found no automatic blip and accepted the downshift without pedal input. One earlier isolated recheck made after the original detector fix returned yes, so no is retained as the latest fuller observation at medium confidence rather than treated as settled real-car behavior. SimHub's clutch channel cannot distinguish the driver's pedal from a car-side clutch intervention.
control_notes: Simulator behavior was observed in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with automatic clutch and shifting disabled. The current two-stage downshift test found no automatic blip and the gear engaged without pedal input.
An earlier post-fix isolated recheck returned automatic blip yes. The newer full guided drive returned no, so the current result is recorded at medium confidence and remains explicitly falsifiable.
The FIA rules establish dogbox construction for the SuperCar but not the exact AMS2 shift behavior; no real-world automatic-blip conclusion is inferred from their silence.
records.driver_summary: Six-speed sequential stick in AMS2. Use the clutch to launch; the car accepts flat clutchless upshifts and coast downshifts without pedal work. The current drive found no automatic blip, at medium confidence because one earlier recheck disagreed.
